last.verdict: Strong cloud beat, but heavy AI spending left the stock flat.

reasons.label: Azure accelerates
reasons.text: Azure grew 48%, above Microsoft's own 44-45% forecast, with Microsoft Cloud up 30%.

reasons.label: Huge AI spending
reasons.text: Capital spending hit $45.2 billion, up about 30% from a year ago.

reasons.label: Backlog jumps
reasons.text: Contracted future cloud revenue rose 73% to $677 billion, a demand signal.

story: Azure growth has risen from 39% in January, when the stock fell nearly 10%, to 40% in April and 43% in July, when shares rose about 8%. October reached 48%, yet AI spending returns remain the central worry.
